name: Glitchcore
garments: not a fashion look — primarily a digital-image style (fashion crossover is minimal and borrowed from y2k/cybergoth)

media.title: early datamoshing experiments (2000s video art)
media.note: the technical ancestor: deliberately corrupted video codecs

reacts_against: clean, over-produced social media imagery; glitchcore treats visual corruption as the point rather than an error to hide.

findings: a vivid streak — roughly 63% of the color measured is highly saturated
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
